p.t: Extreme Makeover: Home Edition Latin America
p.d: Un programa basado en el original Extreme Makeover de EE. UU., en donde un equipo de diseñadores reconstruyen y embellecen la casa de gente necesitada en un tiempo muy corto.
Tres miembros de la Brigada de Homicidios de Austria comparten sus labores policiales con Rex, un pastor alemán entrenado como perro policía.
La mejor información de deportiva de Panamá y el mundo.

Una nueva toma en la serie clásica de 1970 del mismo nombre, trae a tres bellezas frescas para resolver los casos de difícil millonario Charlie Townsend. La princesa de Park Avenue, que se convirtió en ladrón Abby (Rachael Taylor), la desacreditada policía de Miami Kate (Annie Ilonzeh) y la misteriosa corredora de la calle Eva (Minka Kelly) forman una estrecha amistad, ya que tienen una segunda oportunidad en la vida como detectives en la soleada Miami. Aunque son desconocidos cuando se juntan, una cosa es cierta: que siempre se cubrirán las espaldas unas a otras. Drew Barrymore, quien co-protagonizó la película "Los ángeles de Charlie", es la productora ejecutiva de la serie.
Tres miembros de la Brigada de Homicidios de Austria comparten sus labores policiales con Rex, un pastor alemán entrenado como perro policía.

Un teniente de policía se debate entre la fidelidad al cuerpo y la vinculación que mantiene con los amigos junto a los que creció en las calles más duras de Los Ángeles, para quienes, a menudo, la policía es el enemigo.
Los accidentes catastróficos en la historia de la aviación son reproducidos meticulosamente para determinar si estos desastres pudieron haber sido prevenidos.
A fierce demon has its eye on Prue and Phoebe; Piper's superstition about relationships starting on Friday the 13th has her frustrated.
Prue receives a plea for help from Max, a 13-year-old witch who has been kidnapped by a pair of vicious thugs.
An earthquake unleashes a shadow demon which turns Phoebe toward her dark side and against her family.
Prue's incantation to multiply her strength goes awry when Phoebe has a vision showing Prue being stabbed.
To protect themselves from a power-stealing warlock, the sisters time travel to the 1970s where they encounter their family.
Lilly and Jeffries reopen a case when the mother of a murdered boy finds a letter suggesting that his death was not a random act of violence.
During the reinvestigation of a ballplayer found bludgeoned to death in 1945, Lilly and Jeffries run out of leads and must retrace their steps if they hope to collar the killer.
An elderly woman who died of natural causes was using the identity of a woman who disappeared after being committed to a mental hospital in the 1950s.
A woman loses her fourth son to gang violence, and Lilly determines to stop the cycle and save her remaining child by convicting gang leader Miguel Maldonado.
Recovery of an electronic diary prompts the team to reopen the investigation into the death of a healthy young woman who suffered a stress-induced heart attack when her dot-com company crashed.

Bullied as a teen for being overweight, Bob Stone shows up to his high school reunion looking fit and muscular. While there, he finds Calvin Joyner, a fast-talking accountant who misses his glory days as a popular athlete. Stone is now a lethal CIA agent who needs Calvin's number skills to help him save the compromised U.S. spy satellite system. Together, the former classmates encounter shootouts, espionage and double-crosses while trying to prevent worldwide chaos.

Three years after the destruction of the Jurassic World theme park, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing return to the island of Isla Nublar to save the remaining dinosaurs from a volcano that's about to erupt. They soon encounter terrifying new breeds of gigantic dinos while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens the entire planet.

Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever.
Un agente de la DEA emprende una sangrienta venganza luego de que miembros de un cártel asesinan a su esposa.

Mickey Pearson, un estadounidense expatriado en Londres, se ha hecho rico con el negocio de la marihuana. Sin embargo, cuando se difunde el rumor de que va a vender su imperio, varios criminales se disputan la oportunidad que se les presenta.
Gracie Hart, agente del FBI, se enfrenta a sus superiores para salvar a dos amigas que fueron secuestradas en Las Vegas.
El superperro Krypto se une a un grupo de divertidos y descerebrados animales para que lo ayuden a rescatar a los superhéroes de la Liga de la Justicia, que han sido secuestrados.

p.t: Animales fantásticos: Los secretos de Dumbledore
p.d: El poderoso mago Grindelwald se está moviendo para tomar el control del mundo mágico. Incapaz de detenerlo solo, el profesor Dumbledore le encarga al magizoólogo Newt Scamander una peligrosa misión.

El mayor sueño de todo niño y no tan niño es tener superpoderes. El universo cinematográfico de DC presenta a Billy Batson, un joven huérfano que, gracias a un misterioso hechicero, se convierte en superhéroe al decir "¡Shazam!". En un cuerpo adulto y con corazón de niño, Billy deberá aprender a usar sus nuevos poderes para combatir las fuerzas del mal.
Billy Batson y sus hermanos adoptivos Freddy, Mary, Pedro, Eugene y Darla, también dotados de superpoderes, tienen que enfrentarse a las tres hijas de Atlas: Hespera, Calipso y Anthea.
Batman explora la corrupción existente en la ciudad de Gotham y el vínculo de esta con su propia familia. Además, entra en conflicto con un asesino en serie conocido como "el Acertijo".

A fierce demon has its eye on Prue and Phoebe; Piper's superstition about relationships starting on Friday the 13th has her frustrated.
Prue receives a plea for help from Max, a 13-year-old witch who has been kidnapped by a pair of vicious thugs.
An earthquake unleashes a shadow demon which turns Phoebe toward her dark side and against her family.
Prue's incantation to multiply her strength goes awry when Phoebe has a vision showing Prue being stabbed.
To protect themselves from a power-stealing warlock, the sisters time travel to the 1970s where they encounter their family.
Lilly and Jeffries reopen a case when the mother of a murdered boy finds a letter suggesting that his death was not a random act of violence.
During the reinvestigation of a ballplayer found bludgeoned to death in 1945, Lilly and Jeffries run out of leads and must retrace their steps if they hope to collar the killer.
An elderly woman who died of natural causes was using the identity of a woman who disappeared after being committed to a mental hospital in the 1950s.
A woman loses her fourth son to gang violence, and Lilly determines to stop the cycle and save her remaining child by convicting gang leader Miguel Maldonado.
Recovery of an electronic diary prompts the team to reopen the investigation into the death of a healthy young woman who suffered a stress-induced heart attack when her dot-com company crashed.

Bullied as a teen for being overweight, Bob Stone shows up to his high school reunion looking fit and muscular. While there, he finds Calvin Joyner, a fast-talking accountant who misses his glory days as a popular athlete. Stone is now a lethal CIA agent who needs Calvin's number skills to help him save the compromised U.S. spy satellite system. Together, the former classmates encounter shootouts, espionage and double-crosses while trying to prevent worldwide chaos.

Three years after the destruction of the Jurassic World theme park, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing return to the island of Isla Nublar to save the remaining dinosaurs from a volcano that's about to erupt. They soon encounter terrifying new breeds of gigantic dinos while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens the entire planet.

Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever.

p.t: Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore
p.d: Professor Albus Dumbledore knows the powerful, dark wizard Gellert Grindelwald is moving to seize control of the wizarding world. Unable to stop him alone, he entrusts magizoologist Newt Scamander to lead an intrepid team of wizards and witches. They soon encounter an array of old and new beasts as they clash with Grindelwald's growing legion of followers.

We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities.

Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world.

Batman ventures into Gotham City's underworld when a sadistic killer leaves behind a trail of cryptic clues. As the scale of the perpetrator's plans become clear, he must bring justice to the abuse of power and corruption that plagues the metropolis.

Galactic criminal Riddick (Vin Diesel) is on the run, with bounty hunters on his tail. He receives guidance from Aereon (Judi Dench), ambassador from the Elemental race, who informs him that a warrior army known as the Necromongers is annihilating all human life in the galaxy in a bid for universal dominance. The wise Aereon urges Riddick into battle, believing he is the one man who can defeat the Necromongers and their leader, the evil Lord Marshal (Colm Feore).

p.t: Overwhelmed with IRS Debt? Keys to Resolving Tax Debt
p.d: See how one company is changing people's lives by helping them put their tax problems to rest.
Three comedians and lifelong friends compete to embarrass each other amongst the public with a series of hilarious and outrageous dares.
The Jokers are back taking offense at baristas and reading unusual product reviews; one Joker will be punished by provoking diners with one difficult task.
Kicking good people out and stealing from strangers is what's on the agenda for the Jokers; one of them ruins the entire night of a whole sports bar.
The Jokers are snagging tips and spinning the Wheel of Doom to determine who will be the losing Joker, who will be excusing his bad behavior with a very generous compensation.
From bombing job interviews to trashing their Nona's sauce, the Jokers are not on their game; one Loser is punished by confronting cellphone users.
Busy week for the Jokers as they fake their marriage and interview folks for an upcoming lifestyle article, but one Loser couldn't keep up and will be forced to curse out in tonight's punishment.
Reporting crimes and disrupting mealtimes in new challenges, but in the end, one Joker has to shed light onto something or someone important to complete his punishment.
The Jokers are hiding from their boss; they try to get away with sending bizarre emails; one loser won't make it through and is caught red-handed messing with women's purses.

The Jokers come in hot and correct rude behavior but not before adding an unusual fee to customers' bills; one of them couldn't wrap his mind around winning, so he must wrap his legs around something else.
The Jokers are at Raising Cane's, and following that, asking for help to carry some furniture; one of them will be strapped to a speeding race car for his punishment.
The team scouts for the next child star while trying not to laugh as Dan Jost reads his honest movie reviews in a focus group.

The Jokers are breaking and entering a home for a commercial where they showcase their wackiest and over the top performances; to top it off, one loser will be trolling his way through the Liberty Science Center's Touch Tunnel!
Looks like the guys are selling sunsets, while later asking for help to film a bizarre video; one must lose and that one, must help a horse lose something from down under.

One-star reviews are what Sal, Q, and Murr will be combating, and then testing their acting chops with special celebrity guest, Richard Kind; at the end, one of them will be forced to cut the line at a grocery store, over, and over, and over, and over.

p.t: The Hunt for the World's End Killers
p.d: Ian Rankin explains that by the dawn of the 80s, the only hope for catching the World's End killers lay with the people developing new techniques in forensic science. Astonishing archive footage reveals how policing underwent a revolution throughout the decade, fuelled by advances in forensic science, DNA fingerprinting and information technology.
Conversation about Scotland's biggest news stories, hosted by Martin Geissler.

Sharks are a mainstay of Steve's Deadly 60, slicing through his ratings with their size, speed and power. They are among the most spectacular predators on the planet - but they're in trouble.

The rainforests of Ecuador are some of the most diverse on earth. Brimming with all kinds of unique and weird species that are found nowhere else, and some of the most deadly animals on earth lurking in the shadows.

Stacey witnesses a shocking surgery in Miami where people have their legs broken to get six inches taller, and questions if drinking toxic laundry powder can really cure joint pain.

Contestants compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
The game show that mixes general knowledge quizzing and bowling.
Jason Manford hosts the quiz show where players face a question and pick from a board of six rankable answers. Some answers are good, but only one is unbeatable.

Sara Pascoe welcomes 12 of Britain's most talented home sewers into the sewing room, which is in a historic woollen mill on the outskirts of Leeds. Week One sees judges Patrick Grant and Esme Young ask them to create a capsule wardrobe consisting of three items. First, for the Pattern Challenge, they must produce a wool mini skirt with piped patch pockets.

They may be the most isolated in the world, but every one of the region's 20,000 islands has been colonised. This is the story of the ultimate castaways - from saltwater crocodiles and giant eels to crested iguanas - who have reached islands thousands of miles apart. The voyages of the South Pacific's first people, the Polynesians, were no less remarkable. Their journeys were some of the greatest ever undertaken.

Paul Martin presents from Muncaster Castle in Cumbria. Experts Caroline Hawley and James Lewis choose items to take to auction. James is drawn to a collection of WWI memorabilia and Caroline finds an exciting collection of postcards. Plus, Paul meets an artist whose work has led him back in time to the ancient art of relief printing.

Jennie Bond, James Bye, Kadeena Cox and Aurie Styla take on a series of quiz rounds selected by quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quick-fire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week.

Clive heads to one of the Dominican Republic's most northerly provinces to the beautiful city of Puerto Plata. He learns about the incredible story of the Jewish refugees that found shelter in this country during World War II.

Als die Familie frühzeitig aus dem Urlaub zurückkommen, stellen sie entsetzt fest, dass ein Straßenfest in der Nachbarschaft stattfindet. Das Fest findet jedes Jahr genau zu der Zeit statt, in der die Familie im Urlaub ist.
Malcolm bekommt die Stelle zum Chefredakteur im Literaturmagazin der Schule zugesagt. Malcolm veröffentlicht einen Artikel, der ihn in Schwierigkeiten mit der Schulleitung bringt.
Flower behindert aufgrund einer Prophezeiung die Eröffnung des Restaurants von Jay.
Bastian und Svenja verwickeln sich einmal wieder in einen Streit miteinander. Zu allem Übel lässt Svenja Bastian verfluchen und dieser wird auf einmal vom Pech verfolgt.

Mit einem satirischen Blick werden Nachrichten aus Politik, Kultur und der Medienwelt unterhaltsam präsentiert. Berühmte Gäste und Moderatoren arbeiten aktuelle Ereignisse humoristisch auf und kommentieren die politische Weltlage.

Stan und Roger hatten einen harten Tag. Frustriert geraten die beiden aneinander und plötzlich tauschen sie die Körper und müssen einige Zeit im Körper des anderen verbringen. Mit teils fatalen Folgen! Roger wird mit dem Druck in Stans Büro nicht fertig und Stan fühlt sich in der Rolle Rogers schlicht unnütz.

Fry möchte alle jemals gedrehten TV-Sendungen in einer einzigen Sitzung im Zug ansehen. Dieses ambitionierte Unterfangen treibt ihn schnell an den Rand des Wahnsinns. Die Frage stellt sich, ob es ihm gelingen oder er kläglich scheitern wird.
Die Kinder von Amy und Kif tauchen aus einem Alien-Sumpf auf.

Tina will unbedingt ihr musikalisches Idol treffen und nimmt an einem Wettbewerb teil, der als Gewinn ein Treffen ermöglicht. Bob und Linda erfahren unterdessen Neuigkeiten über das Restaurant, die zu Spannungen zwischen den beiden führen.

Tina überredet ihre Eltern, sie am Reitlager teilnehmen zu lassen. Dazu muss sie sich jedoch von ihrem imaginären Pferd verabschieden. Linda verfolgt eine eigene Idee und richtet ein Restaurantlager für Gene und Louise ein.
Beliebte Stars sterben oft an einer Überdosis. Stan soll entlarvt werden, Drogen zu verkaufen.
Es ist Halloween und eine böse Hexe nutzt ihre Zauberkräfte, um South Park zu terrorisieren.

Francine möchte so wie in alten Zeiten mit der Familie in den Mittelalter-Freizeitpark "Familyland" fahren. Dort angekommen wird versehentlich der tiefgefrorene, böse Gründer des Parks, Roy Family, aufgetaut.

Stan fährt zu einem Junggesellenabschied nach Atlantic City. Als sein bester Freund ihm aus dem Weg geht, schreitet Roger ein und beweist sich als guter Kumpel. Währenddessen haben es sich Hayley und Steve zur Aufgabe gemacht, ein Traumpaar auseinander zu bringen.

Alex' Plan, ihren Kunstlehrer zu beeindrucken, wird von ihrer Familie vereitelt. Luke hat derweil ein Feuer in seiner Schule gelöscht und erhält eine Medaille. Doch Manny weiß, dass er diese nicht verdient hat. Gloria hat einen Eifersuchtsanfall.
Frank becomes a wanted man after he catches the ball at a college football game and refuses to give it back to the kicker.
When Marie receives a letter from a relative detailing how wonderful her life is, it drives her insane with jealousy, and she enlists Debra's help in writing a Barone family update.

When Debra grudgingly agrees to let him be more involved in the daily decision-making, Ray starts grocery shopping for things that he likes, and he chooses where the family will go on its next holiday.
Held captive at Frank and Marie's during a snowstorm, Debra, Ray and Amy actually find themselves having a great time until Debra makes a nasty comment to Frank that totally upsets the good mood.
When Sabrina realises she has been turning down guys right and left since her break-up, she casts a spell to turn herself into a dating machine.
Sabrina's evil twin steals her passport, abandoning Sabrina in the other realm with Zelda's evil twin.
Sabrina and Roxie (Melissa Joan Hart, Soleil Moon Frye) team up to write an exposé for the school newspaper a la Woodward and Bernstein.
Sabrina (Melissa Joan Hart) unknowingly pushes Miles (Trevor Lissauer) into a cult whose leader (guest star Richard Kline) claims to be a witch.
After weeks of procrastinating, Rachel finally takes down the Christmas lights, but sprains her ankle.
When the girls lose money to the guys in a poker match, they seek out Monica's Aunt Iris, a famous card player, for lessons in poker and demand a rematch.
Rachel accidentally lets Ross's pet monkey escape, and the friends form a search party. She is then horrified to learn that her former best friend is engaged to marry her ex-fiancé.

Rachel gets back together with her ex-fiancé Barry, even though he's engaged to her best friend Mindy. Meanwhile, Chandler agonises over a wonderful woman who fails to call him after their first date.
Someone is pretending to be Monica, using her credit card numbers and having the sort of fun that Monica wishes she could have.
Monica discovers that she's developed a highly mature approach to her latest love affair, and Ross finds out that he's being mistaken for a male prostitute.

When Carol gives birth, Ross and Susan almost miss the event when Phoebe accidentally locks them in a cupboard together to put a stop to their constant bickering. Meanwhile, Joey befriends an unmarried pregnant woman and ends up helping her to give birth.
Mike stands in the way of Nikki and Arthur's relationship, and inadvertently causes a taxi driver strike.
Mike wears a fat suit for a day when the city's new public toilets turn out to be inaccessible to overweight people.
Monica and Chandler disagree over how to redecorate Rachel's old room and despite Phoebe's admonitions, Ross makes a drastic decision about Rachel.
After learning that his health insurance has lapsed because he has not worked enough as an actor, Joey suffers a painful hernia, and Rachel finally finds out that Ross never annulled their marriage.
Rachel forces Ross to terminate their marriage, Phoebe's first triplet babysitting experience proves stressful, and Joey pretends to own a German sports car.
It's the last night before Chandler moves into Monica's apartment, leaving Joey alone and prompting Rachel to make plans to move in with Phoebe.
Deplorable deeds featuring delinquent duos, drunk drivers, and daring escapes.
A smorgasbord of crime featuring action-packed getaways and some adolescent law-breakers.
The guys try to get strangers to follow them to a made-up basement, try to get customers to call out a ridiculous nickname, and try to get a stranger to agree with their silly life lessons.

A naked man makes a scene on a Miami Beach, a drunk driver finds a strange and dangerous place to relieve himself, and the mayor of a Minnesota town finds himself in police custody.

A defendant announces college baseball scores during his murder trial. A man facing drug charges gets caught smoking marijuana in the virtual courtroom. And a domestic violence suspect threatens a judge.

A look at the shocking murder of 19-year-old shop assistant Rachel Manning at the hands of Shahidul Ahmed in Milton Keynes. Manning's boyfriend, Barri White, was convicted of the crime, before his sentence was overturned in 2008.
The story of Louise Wigan, who vanished aged 15 in 1995. The next day, her body was found in a field near her home, leading to a hunt for a killer in Appley Bridge.
The shocking murder of 51-year-old Wendy Speakes, who was targeted as she walked home from work and killed by sadistic killer Christopher Farrow, who had a fetish for women's shoes.
When a late-night party in the home of a celebrity basketball player turns deadly, a curious web of lies leads detectives on a rocky road to the truth to find justice for the unlikely victim.

A woman walked into the Redmond Police Station, bringing with her a harrowing story of betrayal and exploitation. Believing she had found companionship in an online relationship, she became ensnared in a complex and sinister web of manipulation.
After connecting with a woman on a dating app, 22-year-old Tyrell Truss got in his car thinking he was driving to a date. In reality, he was heading to his death.

88 women fell victim to a romance fraud scheme run by Rubbin Sarpong. Sarpong posed as a US soldier stationed in Syria. The goal was to gain trust and then ask for money, all under the guise of needing help transporting gold bars out of Syria.
Missy Berry, a fast-food manager, is found dead in a running car at a deserted intersection.
In Mobile, Alabama, a man is gunned down in front of his family, and it's up to Detective Jermaine Rogers to sift through differing accounts of the incident to find the truth.

Law Professor Dan Markel was shot dead as he pulled into the driveway of his Tallahassee, Florida home. The killers were hit men from the Latin Kings drug gang, but in a shocking twist, detectives discovered they had been hired to kill Markel.

p.t: The Death Investigator With Barbara Butcher
p.d: A woman is found dead in a lift - but her murder is just the beginning. As Barbara Butcher retraces the chain of evidence, she uncovers a domino effect of violence that leaves a trail of bodies across the Bronx.
A police shooting sparks a Blue Alert and a frantic manhunt. As detectives dig deeper, conflicting evidence and witness accounts point to a chilling possibility.

Customs officers spring into action after receiving news of a sinking boat - on land. Sergeant Steve uses good old-fashioned leg work to track down two stolen scooters and return them to their rightful owners.

Rick heads for the little known region of Extremadura and samples its most celebrated foods - pimentón and Ibérico ham. In his old camper van, he continues on south to the romantic city of Sevilla, the home of tapas and flamenco.

p.t: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
p.d: Rick's journey begins in the magnificent city of Venice and on the idyllic Greek island of Symi he cooks some of his favourite Venetian dishes: seafood risotto, tiramisu and gnocchi with spider crab.

Freddie Flintoff transforms a Sinclair C5 into a bobsleigh and tackles a terrifying Norwegian luge track. Elsewhere, the team sample some classic TV cop cars before going head-to-head in an all-action police chase.

Freddie, Chris and Paddy attempt to qualify as lorry drivers before embarking on a stormy HGV road trip across Britain, and a spot of truck racing. Out on track, Chris runs the rule over the beautiful new Lotus Emira.

Paul and Bob head to the River Ouse in the heart of Bedfordshire. The river was once famous for barbel, but has recently become renowned for its big perch instead, a fish that has so far eluded them. Bob makes Paul a dinner he will never forget.

p.t: James May's Cars of the People
p.d: James downsizes to explore the weird world of the microcar. Discover how austerity and fears of congestion led to European tragicomic disasters in the shape of Britain's infamous three wheelers, French death traps and German absurdities.

Dave and Si explore how the British love affair with beer and cider has evolved over centuries. At one time it was safer to drink beer than water and the Bikers visit a cider festival, where they press their own.

Paul, Bob and Ted travel a short distance to Thornwood Springs Fishery in Essex, a complex of three lakes on the edges of Epping Forest, in search of a big rudd - although there's also the chance of a trout in the waters.

Rob Brydon is back in the host's chair with Lee Mack and David Mitchell returning as the team captains. Sorting the fact from the fiction this week are guests Les Dennis, Richard Osman, Alice Levine and Lou Sanders.
Joining Rob Brydon, Lee Mack and David Mitchell for this week's tall tales are guests Stephen Hendry, Laura Whitmore, Chris McCausland and Maisie Adam.

Quiz show in which contestants are rewarded more for being `quite interesting'. In this extended episode, Stephen Fry is joined by Ross Noble, Jack Dee, Phill Jupitus and Alan Davies as they attempt to answer questions about a hodge-podge of topics beginning with the letter H.

p.t: Have I Got a Bit More News for You
p.d: Steph McGovern is guest host with panellists broadcaster Carol Vorderman and comedian Nabil Abdulrashid joining team captains Paul Merton and Ian Hislop as they delve into the news.

After the loader fire, Jared faces a new reality: wildfire threat. Adrian is tasked with reviving a rusted fire engine, while fallers fall high-dollar timber. But when road damage shuts down their main haul route, the operation grinds to a halt.

A couple constructs an upcycled off-grid homestead deep in the sprawling South Carolina islands; plans for the catamaran-style home include a luxury yacht aesthetic, but the couple must build during hurricane season to meet their deadline.
A novice builder attempts to construct a cabin in Vermont's White River Valley. The harsh winter and his lack of experience make this a challenging build.

When lesser flamingo eggs and chicks are being preyed upon, the team makes a nerve-wracking decision; Wallaby Thelma and her joey, Everest, become ambassador animals; a new perch is created for Stuart, the young fishing cat.

After taking over the former red river hog habitat, a gazelle gives the team a big surprise; staffers race to prepare a den when they suspect the Amur leopard Satka is pregnant; koalas are nursed back to health after being saved from bushfires.
Delana and Darien are hoping to buy their first home near the Kenai River. However, this musical couple can't afford to break the bank, so search for a bargain.
Jeff and Heather, a newly engaged couple, love the water so much that they're searching for a home right on the glacier-fed Kenai River.
Gabe and Mikela live in a dry cabin and must haul their water from the grocery store every day, and they're tired of their high-maintenance home.
Glennallen, Alaska is home to many remote, beautiful lakes. After living in their crowded bed and breakfast, that's exactly where Eric and Cynthia want to live.
A single mum watches her family's dream of a Big Island coffee farm fade. Under threat from wild hogs, invasive bamboo, and a lack of water, the Raneys must clear a path to survival.
A Peugeot 205 T16 inspires Mike to upgrade its under-powered UK counterpart for a track race. Can Mike's 205 Rallye compete with a Eurospec Peugeot?
Mike and Elvis get to work on an iconic Japanese rally car: a Mitsubishi Lancer Evo7. It needs a total engine rebuild and a new look if it is to be king of the street racers once again.
In Japan, Mike and Elvis take on a dream car, a 1990s Honda NSX. But a fundamental issue brings one of their biggest challenges ever.

The '33 Roadster hits a roadblock, as the hard top is proving difficult for the upholstery shop. Dave and his team are busy designing custom gauges and wheels, while coming up with new-take headlights and taillights.

Supermassive black holes are so large they devour stars and shape galaxies. The latest science may answer why they grow so large.
Adam joins forces with a NASA engineer to rebuild a rocket-propelled super weapon. Originally built to breach barbed wire in WWII, they aim to fix its fatal flaws.
Using material salvaged from scrapyards, Adam and two colleagues design and build three motorised monsters of destruction, inspired by post-apocalyptic worlds.

A strange cave freezes in summer and melts in winter, and a huge sand dune swallows a small child in an instant. Rob and Stefan explore these mysteries.

The solar system is different to others in the Milky Way, but it hides a violent past. Scientists examine the clues to reveal its secret history and new discoveries reveal that the Earth and planets were formed from the destruction of strange worlds.

Space is not as empty as it seems. It conceals a secret structure called spacetime - an invisible field that governs our lives and controls the universe. This strange four-dimensional substances will also determine how our universe will end.
Neutron stars are violent phenomena that defy the laws of physics. New discoveries reveal they are far more deadly than previously believed and have the power to destroy planets and even other stars.

Ein Mann aus Westlondon hat es versäumt, seine Strafzettel in Höhe von 2.000 Euro zu bezahlen. Der Gerichtsvollzieher Gary Brown und sein Auszubildender sind damit beauftragt, das Geld einzutreiben, doch der Mann reagiert extrem aggressiv.

Ein Mann aus Wiltshire hat es versäumt, dem Vermieter seiner Garage 2.200 Euro zu bezahlen. Die Gerichtsvollzieher Gareth Short und Mitch Starr besuchen den arbeitslosen Koch, der sich sehr ungerecht behandelt fühlt, und besprechen eine Lösung.

Matt und Andres bekommen Unterstützung von dem ESA-Astronauten Matthias Maurer. Da die Ausbeute jedoch zu wünschen übrig lässt, wollen sie ihr Glück in einer schwer zugänglichen Region versuchen. Doch die Anfahrt ist schwerer als gedacht.

Das Team war bei der Schatzsuche erfolgreich. Mit den Nuggets kann Mat in Down Under die Miete für den Monster-Truck bezahlen, mit dem sein Goldgräber-Nachbar Greg das Schürfgut transportiert. Jetzt haben die Abenteurer Blut geleckt.

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: Auf gleich zwei Booten kommt die Arbeit zum Erliegen. Während ein Kapitän ins Krankenhaus muss, ist der andere bei einem Besäufnis. Noch dazu wird auf hoher See ein gesuchter Schwerverbrecher auf einem der Boote entdeckt und das Licht fällt auf einem weiteren Boot komplett aus.

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: Einer der Kapitäne sieht auf hoher See dem möglichen Ende seiner Karriere entgegen. Ein Kollege weigert sich einen Entzug mitzumachen. Die mutigen Männer und Frauen der US Coast Guard trauern um einen ihrer Männer, den sie auf See verloren haben.

p.t: Border Control: Türkei - Grenzschützer im Einsatz
p.d: Eine Reisende aus Ägypten hat am Flughafen Sabiha Gökçen in Istanbul angeblich Schwierigkeiten, sich an den Schlosscode zu erinnern. Doch als eine Beamtin androht, den Koffer aufzubrechen, fällt ihr die Zahlenkombination plötzlich wieder ein.

In Helsingborg verstricken sich die Insassen eines Fahrzeugs in Widersprüche. Die beiden Personen werden vom Zoll getrennt voneinander befragt. Ihre Aussagen werfen bei den Beamten Fragen auf. Deshalb haken die Grenzschützer intensiv nach.

Die Offenburger Pfandleiher Daniel Lieser und Axel Zoor nehmen einen Spielautomaten mit Kultfaktor in Augenschein. Hält das Gerät, was es verspricht? Azubi Jabez Frisch bedient derweil in Karlsruhe eine Frau, die einen Ring zu Geld machen will.

Im Paramount Pawn erleben Florian und Jabez, wie selbstverständlich in amerikanischen Pfandleihhäusern mit Schusswaffen gehandelt wird. Dabei landet auch ein Stück aus dem Jahr 1922 auf dem Ladentresen - inklusive historischem Nachweis.

Der Saisonendspurt entwickelt sich zu einem spannenden Kopf-an-Kopf-Rennen zwischen Parker Schnabel und seinem Rivalen Tony Beets. Noch liegt der "König des Klondike" mit etwa 120 Unzen in Führung. Doch Parker verliert nur ungern.

In Arizona setzt ein Goldgräber seine Rente aufs Spiel, um seinem Sohn ein Erbe zu sichern. Freddy und Juan müssen die Hitze erhöhen, um die innovative, vom Bergmann selbst entworfene Trockenwaschanlage zu reparieren und so die Mine zu retten.

Die Sendung informiert über alle wichtigen Neuigkeiten aus der Welt. Die Zuschauer bekommen so einen Überblick über den aktuellen Stand verschiedenster Themen wie Gesellschaft, Kultur, Politik, Sport, Wirtschaft und Zeitgeschehen.

Eric Komberec will bewahren, was sein Vater Dick in den vergangenen 50 Jahren aufgebaut hat. Aber das wird nicht leicht. Der Schlüssel zum Erfolg ist oft eine hocheffiziente Waschanlage. Freddy Dodge und Juan Ibarra packen das Schweißgerät aus.

From a container paradise to an arty mountain abode, some off-the-grid builders try to create private retreats perfect for building family memories.

Building off-the-grid can be magical if you're perched in the canopies of a lush green forest. From an A-Frame in the Black Hills to massive mud house in the Cascades, these cabins in the woods are sure to offer million-dollar views!
Crab fishermen risk their lives as they battle Arctic weather, brutal waves and a ticking clock for big money in this modern-day gold rush on the Bering Sea.
Gold miners Boyce and Ben separately head into the bush of British Columbia, seeking the next big pay streak. Completely alone in the wilderness, they race against winter to hit gold.

Josh traverses England, Wales and Scotland, wading through history and legend to search for evidence of a real King Arthur. In Wales, Josh has a close call rappelling into the hundreds of miles of underground caves.

Josh journeys across England uncovering the true stories behind the legendary Robin Hood. Josh explores underground tunnels that Robin used to escape confinement, and he finds what appears to be Robin's final resting place.

In Mississippi, the Raneys must first solve the mystery of flooding water before teaching a family of six to thrive off-grid together. Builds include a new Elvis-inspired Heartbreak Goat-tel goat pen, garden compound and metal forge.
The Bushmen dig a passage to a new emergency shaft. The Mooka Boys use a crane to lift a homemade shelter over the Lunatic Opal Field.
Loner Dan Measey needs money quickly and gambles on new, untested AI technology to detect opal. Slim Pickings has to move.
Shane and Russell take the biggest gamble of their season. Marcus, Linden and Dale desperately need new ground before intense heat shuts down their operation.
The Gold Timers negotiate a lucrative deal to sell their mining rights. Torrential summer storms in Victoria threaten to shut down the Poseidon Crew's operation.
In an effort to spend more time with their kids, a couple sets out to build a treehouse in remote Maryland.

Friends and natural builders set out to construct a family adobe dome home using the earth onsite in a mountain range in Calif; just as they get into a rhythm, Mother Nature hits them hard with heat waves, fires, earthquakes and a hurricane.

Phil and Heather journey into the Florida Everglades on the hunt for the Skunk Ape, a bloodthirsty cryptid said to be menacing in both size and stench. The team heads deep into the swamps before having an unforgettable encounter.
An independent mother of three, plus a jungle savvy Green Beret, takes on the remote wetlands of Guyana.

Set during the uprising of the Sioux nation in the late 19th century, when broken treaties and a gold rush saw their tribal territories invaded once again. The film centres on Jim Bridger, a scout at Fort Phil Kearney, from where the 7th Cavalry rides to try and hold the peace, but the brutal slaying of innocents by a sadistic lieutenant sees the Sioux in full cry and only Bridger's cunning can help save the soldiers.
Wild west tale about a rancher's search for a ruthless and violent outlaw who has kidnapped his fiancé.

The tale of Robin Hood and Maid Marian in their twilight years. Robin, back from the Crusades, finds his love has become the Abbess of a priory and that his arch enemy, the Sheriff of Nottingham still wants him dead.

John, a white man raised by Apaches, is viewed with suspicion by the other passengers in a stagecoach. They force him to sit on the roof of the carriage, but when bandits attack, John is the first man they turn to for help.

p.d: Stars Eddie Redmayne and Felicity Jones and director James Marsh talk about making the moving romantic drama about the relationship between Stephen and Jane Hawking.

Sara is an overweight teen who witnesses a stranger kidnap a clique of girls who bully her on a regular basis. When police start asking questions, Sara keeps quiet as she's torn between revealing the truth or protecting the man who saved her.

A basketball star and his girlfriend disappear while sailing. Can investigators track down his brother, who's the only person who may know what happened?

An off-duty police officer pulls a gun on another motorist. A machete-wielding man attacks a delivery driver. An angry commuter in an SUV stalks a cyclist. A man takes out his aggression on a defenseless driver.

In 1964, ITV broadcast a film about fourteen seven-year-olds. It became the longest running documentary series ever. Those children are now seventy. 7 Up set out to prove that Britain was divided by the class system - that these children's futures had been decided by the street they were born on. The production team had three weeks to find them. They went to some of the poorest parts of the country and some of the most privileged, and came back with ten boys and four girls. The series became one of British television's most remarkable social experiments, the cameras dipping into their lives every seven years. Children from different parts of the class system who have now become friends. This special programme looks at the year 7 Up was made, the idea behind it, and what they hoped for in a Britain about to change around them.
Lewis stresses over his future with Vinny, Kev is worried about Nicola and keeps his secret, fearing the reaction.
Christina's first day in her new role provides a shock to the system, Carl's latest conquest upsets Debbie, Lucy apologises to Sally, and Susie secures an audition for a musical.
Adelaide's painting is vandalized, and the gallery owner is killed, but Jasper is distracted from the case when he learns of the DNA test on him and the Dean.

It's time for double dates as Ella, Dan, Diags and Jodie go out together for the night; the boys are happy that they can go out with their girls together, but Chloe makes a comment at Jordan's party to Dan about Ella that riles the group up.

Dawson is recruited by his dad and Principal Green to produce a film for the football pep rally, but the stars of the film end up being Dawson and his lady friend Eve, not the Capeside Minutemen. Meanwhile, Pacey has enlisted Joey for assistance in bringing Andie back to Capeside, but their long-awaited reunion doesn't go exactly as Pacey had intended, and Jack comes to an unexpected understanding with his father.
Prue cannot resist the attraction she feels for her kidnapper when she is abducted by a former flame who is fleeing a powerful demon.

Jenna gets the chance to open the boxes that have the power to change lives - she might be able to resist the Banker's tempting offers and go all the way or decide to cut her losses and leave the game early.
Rylan Clark-Neal, Tom Read Wilson brings a touch of class to the Pick 'n Mix challenge.
Graham Norton welcomes essential skills teacher Orla, development manager Kelly, and events duty officer Ben as they take on puzzles and the iconic Wheel in the hope of winning 50,000 pounds.

Dan decides to take Ella camping for their first solo date. Also, Junaid hits a bump in his road to redemption when Elma brings him back to reality, and he realises he has a long way to go before making amends with Girlband.

Gizelle joins Ashley to find new love; Karen and Ray address the work needed to repair their institution; TJ confronts Stacey about the state of their relationship; Wendy braces for a tough conversation with her mother.

p.t: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
p.d: While Kyle gets emotional over her new life, Bozoma tries to make sense of her new future with her man. Sutton plans a trip back home to Augusta with Garcelle and Kyle.

Stephen Mulhern hosts a celebrity special of the classic game show with Adjoa Andoh, Adrian Chiles, and Trevor Nelson all trying to 'say what they see' as they guess well-known phrases for the chance to win a £50,000 jackpot for their chosen charity.
Graham Norton welcomes firefighter Kerrie, financial advisor Richard, and account manager Ciaran as they tackle tough puzzles and face the iconic Wheel for a chance to win 50,000 pounds.
Lee Mack returns as 100 more contestants try to make it all the way to the 1% question and win up to £100,000. Will anyone succeed?

A cast of carefully selected housemates from all walks of life take up residence in the world's most famous reality TV home for up to six weeks, with cameras capturing their every move and the nation following every twist and turn.

Get closer to the personalities, dynamics and relationships at the heart of the show. Big Brother legend Kate Lawler and podcaster supreme GK Barry host exclusive interviews with evicted Housemates, celebrity fans and special guests.
When Lois becomes a postal worker to pay for Stewie's private school, she finds an unsent letter from Peter that was meant for his old fling.

Morse is called in to investigate when a wealthy American tourist is found dead in her hotel. The Oxford detective discovers that her death is linked to the disappearance of a priceless Anglo-Saxon antiquity.
Walker must re-visit his shadowy past in order to solve a spate of violent robberies. David is lured into a web of deceit when a stranger arrives in town.
Ventress puts his acting skills to the test when a shipment of stolen Russian icons is smuggled into the area. Vernon is in hot water again when he and David train Alfred to hunt for truffles.
Ormerod has to make a decision about Caroline, Weatherill's patient is determined to keep details of her illness a secret, and a married couple face the truth about their future.

Sarah and Danny find their relationship tested when Sarah's ex-husband Simon comes to Leopard's Den to get married, but a near-fatal accident makes them value what they have. Rosie takes a ranger's job at Mara, and a giraffe has trouble settling in.

Emmerdale is one of Britain's best-loved and highly viewed long-running drama soaps - set in the heart of the beautiful countryside of the Yorkshire Dales, this realistic and down-to-earth drama superbly chronicles the joys and the heartbreaks of a tightly knit countryside community.

A new police sergeant receives a cool reception when he arrives from the city with big ideas. Elsewhere, PC Walker is distracted by a young nurse at Ashfordly General.

DCI Barnaby investigates the murders of bell ringers from the village church who are being mysteriously murdered one by one. Barnaby and Troy find that they must solve a riddle from the past before the killer strikes again.

Isobel has plans for Downton to continue to help the war wounded in some way, but Cora has other ideas. Elsewhere, Thomas is still scheming.

When a woman is found dead in a hotel room, the personal ads on a website look like they might hold the key, and while Rachel enjoys her secret relationship with Will, Janet investigates speed dating.

In 1964, ITV broadcast a film about fourteen seven-year-olds. It became the longest running documentary series ever. Those children are now seventy. 7 Up set out to prove that Britain was divided by the class system - that these children's futures had been decided by the street they were born on. The production team had three weeks to find them. They went to some of the poorest parts of the country and some of the most privileged, and came back with ten boys and four girls. The series became one of British television's most remarkable social experiments, the cameras dipping into their lives every seven years. Children from different parts of the class system who have now become friends. This special programme looks at the year 7 Up was made, the idea behind it, and what they hoped for in a Britain about to change around them.

In 1964, ITV broadcast a film about fourteen seven-year-olds. It became the longest running documentary series ever. Those children are now seventy. 7 Up set out to prove that Britain was divided by the class system - that these children's futures had been decided by the street they were born on. The production team had three weeks to find them. They went to some of the poorest parts of the country and some of the most privileged, and came back with ten boys and four girls. The series became one of British television's most remarkable social experiments, the cameras dipping into their lives every seven years. Children from different parts of the class system who have now become friends. This special programme looks at the year 7 Up was made, the idea behind it, and what they hoped for in a Britain about to change around them.

China's bamboo forest is full of secrets and surprises, including the legendary giant panda, red panda, and Tibetan macaque.

p.t: Nicobar Islands: A Monkey's Long Tale [NEW]
p.d: Exploring nature's ability to adapt to millions of years of gradual tectonic change and sudden natural disaster with a focus on the Nicobar Islands that were significantly impacted by the 2004 tsunami.
Casey treks deep into Yellowstone's wild backcountry, braving severe cold, freak snowstorms, and dangerous animal encounters.
Following an incident with a porcupine a pack of dogs is in urgent need of Dr Oakley's attention, but the Yukon vet's night doesn't end there.
Dr Michelle Oakley treats a sled dog that's had a run-in with a porcupine and tends to two Icelandic horses.
Explores the diverse ecosystems, primeval forests, and rare wildlife of the Carpathian Mountains across Slovakia, Poland and Romania.
Through the cycle of the seasons, Spain's Sierra de Gredos National Park, one of Europe's most remarkable natural landscapes, is revealed.
Few of Europe's countries boast the wide variety of animals found in Greece, which has led to its mainland being dubbed the 'Serengeti of Europe'.
The 360 team investigates a devastating shark bite in Australia.
The NWS homesteaders race to complete their ideal, backcountry dream homes.
Wrangling snakes is more art than science, and the stakes are high. Get ready to go hand-to-scale and face-to-fang with cold-blooded killers.

Jacqui and Andrew get trapped behind the line of a devastating bushfire, the McGhies bring in new equipment to uncover a gold-rich patch and The Gold Devils are torn apart when a team member goes off on their own.
Slim Pickings are suddenly a man down when Lee shocks Roger with an unexpected injury. The Misfits divide and conquer at their Lunatic Claim.
Gale-force winds threaten the Digi Diggers' dreams of an eco-mine. The Bushmen discover dangerous old workings while clearing out their new mine.

Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life. Metal expert Dominic Chinea takes on a toy carriage, which originally belonged to a young boy born in 1911. Owner Jane inherited it from her father and remembers pulling it along and sitting on it as a child. Most of all, she recalls placing her stuffed toys carefully inside. Dom turns his hand to replacing the battered roof.

The boys are off to the West Country and Oxfordshire, in search of vintage treasure to buy, restore and flog. Their discoveries include rare motoring memorabilia, 1970s kitsch and a fabulous collection of stationary engines.

Series in which Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove nose around people's sheds and garages in search of automotive bargains. Today, in a Cornish surf shack they find a bevy of custom bikes, surf buggies and weird and wonderful objects of all kinds. In Oxfordshire, discoveries include rare motoring memorabilia,1970s kitsch and a fabulous collection of stationary engines. They come, they see, they haggle, they repair and finally sell for a tidy profit.

Series in which Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove nose around people's sheds and garages in search of automotive bargains. Today, Henry and Sam discover a collection of motorbikes on Bodmin Moor accumulated over 25 years. They snap up a Suzuki B120 but selling it on to Henry's mate means they hardly make any money on it. Later, in Redruth, the pair come across Harry Potter's Ford Anglia. They bid for it and take it home where a buyer is not far away - their sound man Tommy wants it.

The boys are back in town and travelling to Redruth, where they're confronted with Roy's sheds and their ramshackle contents. There's everything from a model canary-yellow Lamborghini to Harry Potter's Anglia!

p.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
p.d: The boys are coming to the end of their journey as they head to Wales where Henry converts a Royal Enfield into a classic café racer, and Simon gets an 80s pinball machine back to its best.
Angus finds an old painting that could be worth a fortune and uncovers a pair of designer bondage boots that whip up a frenzy at auction.
Angus faces two epic clear-outs: Simon's Welsh home hides rare novels and a 16th-century lockbox, while Bea's London clutter conceals a violin that could fetch thousands.

Experts Charlie Ross and Izzie Balmer find themselves weaving their classic car through the b-roads of the North Wessex Downs. Charlie decides to play Izzie at her own game and hunts for 'sparkly' antiques. However, he's soon distracted by an exquisite Edwardian box that holds a surprise.
Angus clears a collection of ancient artefacts from the home of a legendary musician. He then helps sisters part with their aunt's treasures.
Auctioneer Angus Ashworth and his team are called out to people's homes with a mission to sift through a lifetime of possessions and find forgotten treasures that can be sold at auction.

Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life. Resident clock expert Steven Fletcher is in receipt of an unusual time piece, a statue of a barmaid holding a swinging pendulum clock dial. These clocks are known for being temperamental but with a good clean and a few replacement parts, Steve has it swinging once more.

An unconventional throuple needs dresses for their wedding, but one bride may have to compromise, so the other can shine. Ashley, a doctor on the front lines of COVID-19, is tying the knot, but not before Ronnie surprises her one last time.
Following the case of a shocking stabbing as a result of a so-called 'honour killing' and the tragic story of a four-year-old who was the victim of a hit-and-run.

p.t: Faking It: Tears of a Crime
p.d: Seventeen-year-old Shafelia's disappearance was a mystery – until her sister was arrested for a robbery. Carol Wardell vanished, and her husband left tied up, however, all was not as it seems.

p.t: On the Case With Paula Zahn
p.d: Can police find the vicious killer of two separate Jane Doe victims, murdered in a shockingly similar way?

In Tacoma, Wash., businessman Larry Howse is killed in the parking garage of his flat building; detectives turn to a security camera, which reveals the unfolding of an execution by two mystery assailants.

After Gayle Isleib is shot to death on April 30, 1996, police identify her coworker, Tyrone Montgomery, as her killer; they find love poems as well as evidence that Montgomery planned to kidnap Isleib and murder her husband.
The Futos are a close-knit family of five who film their lives over many decades; four of them are found brutally murdered, and the slayings uncover a terrible secret.

High achieving Keonte Chavis has always relied on her big, loving family to support her dreams. But when a sudden disappearance leads to a disturbing murder, they all face a dark and terrifying reality... the predator is one of their own.

Donald Lewis is a popular musician who owns a local Jazz Café. Despite being beloved in the community, mystery strikes when he suddenly disappears from his jazz club along with his employee. Detectives must find both of them before it's too late.

The case of an 11-year-old boy who went missing near his home in Newcastle, and a known fantasist claims he has the body of a woman in the boot of his car but this time, he might just be telling the truth.
A couple, just engaged, is found brutally murdered in a car. Investigators don't have a lead until a surveillance camera gives the police its first break.
A young woman is found dead in a Texas landfill. Detectives turn to their only witnesses: video cameras that captured the murderer's attempt to cover his tracks.

Louisiana investigators find Andrew Jasmine in front of his home video game console, riddled with bullet holes. And with shell casings from two different firearms, the crime scene bears the hallmarks of a criminal conspiracy.
When social media influencer Sasha Samsudean is murdered in her Orlando, Florida apartment, shoeprints found at the crime scene lead to her killer.
When a teenager goes missing, detectives struggle for leads. But when surveillance cameras reveal her kidnapping, the case becomes a race to bring her home alive.
Trace the brown bear's evolution from Ice Age giants to modern omnivores. Witness their bond with salmon and the intricate ecosystems that shape their survival.
Nestled on the edge of the ancient city of Jodhpur, the luxurious Temple Gardens are home to a huge troop of Hanuman langurs, who enjoy a peaceful life of bounty but maintain a strict hierarchy.

Diving into a busy summer at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital, where vet Emily takes the pressure off a gassy koala mum. The team fight a wave of lorikeet paralysis syndrome and vet Karina uses a teddy bear to rescue a flying fox pup.
Chimp Gypsy is very unwell, Dodger the capuchin meets some new ladies and chimp Bart has eyes for just one thing.
A health check for newly rescued tamarin Red raises alarm, newcomer capuchin Matty squares up to dominant male Erico and the chimps get a tasty treat.
Across the 3,000 scattered islands of the Bahamas lie incredible natural wonders, from giant pine forests to secret labyrinths of underwater caves, and is home to sharks, turtles, and dolphins.
Hope has more white-tailed deer than any previous year, and rounding them up for release is a bigger challenge than ever before.

Marvel at North America's natural wonders as Lizzie swims through astonishing coral reefs, excavates ancient fossils, and treks through jungles on tropical shores. Observe jaguars prowling a Costa Rican beach and encounter the largest sharks.
Off Colombia's coast a newborn humpback whale draws his first breath.

p.t: Signed, Sealed, Delivered: To the Moon and Back
p.d: The Postables embark on a road trip to track down a rock star and the recipient of a lost letter.
After her public breakup, Charley, determined founder of a dating app, is near bankruptcy. She teams up with Liam, a self-assured and innovative marketing expert, to save her company.

When Tiffany's fiancé calls off their wedding, she's heartbroken that her dream wedding is cancelled. Tiffany convinces an actor to pretend to be her fiancé in exchange for signing him to her agency, and the dream wedding happens for someone.
Michelle is having the worst day as she gets fired and dumped on the very same day.
A single mum agrees to be the partner of a bird enthusiast for a competition but misunderstands and tells everyone she's his new girlfriend instead of just his teammate.
A young gardener enters an Easter floral competition to save her family farm. Along the way, she meets a local pastor who helps restore her lost hope.
Lilly, a hopeless romantic and literary enthusiast, gets the surprise of a lifetime when her favourite author, Jane Austen, comes into her life.
Celebrity stylist Kayli must team up with hotel security chief Mills to track down an iconic piece of fashion history after it goes missing on her watch before the Chicago Costume Gala.
Lawyers Mark and Dana are the perfect married couple until they find themselves on opposite sides of a highly public divorce case involving a warring reality show couple.

En esta alabada sátira, el veterano conductor de noticias Howard Beale (Peter Finch) descubre que lo van a despedir y no está muy feliz por ello. Después de amenazar con suicidarse en la televisión, lanza una diatriba furiosa en vivo, lo que resulta en un aumento de la audiencia de la cadena UBS. Esto le permite a la ambiciosa productora Diana Christensen (Faye Dunaway) desarrollar más programación escandalosa, un concepto que lleva a un extremo inquietante.
Programa que busca promover el diálogo, el debate y la participación ciudadana para generar reflexión y acción.

Un repaso de las noticias ocurridas hasta el final el día. Tiene la información completa de las noticias de último minuto y registra con las cámaras desde el lugar de los hechos para que la audiencia quede bien informada antes de terminar el día.

Venus les cuenta a todos que Camilo no es el buen hombre que dice ser. Priscila lleva a cabo sus planes para evitar que Damián mate a Vladímir. Camilo intenta quemarle la cara a Venus, pero Eduardo logra impedirlo.
Revista matutina con noticias, temas de actualidad, reportajes de farándula, música e información práctica.
Jenny ingresa a un prestigioso colegio a través de una beca, pero Rita se aprovecha de su inocencia para su propio beneficio.

Hay fallas de energía eléctrica en algunos de los departamentos y Luis tiene que ir a trabajar al departamento de los López Pérez. Germán se prepara para su examen de admisión a la preparatoria en línea.

Paulina tiene un complejo porque frente al espejo se ve gordita. Aunque familiares y amigos le dicen que está bien, ella se obsesiona con bajar de peso y pone en riesgo su salud.

Víctor y Paulina son mejores amigos y un día acuden a una discoteca, donde quedan impresionados por un bailarín de nombre Thiago. Ambos tendrán que abrir los ojos para no poner en riesgo su amistad y terminar enloquecidos por el mismo hombre.

Los invitados son personas comunes que se encuentran inmersas en conflictos personales. Se trata la problemática de los vecinos, los amigos, los compañeros de trabajo, las parejas, las familias y de todos los grupos sociales donde surja conflicto.

p.t: Mujer, casos de la vida real: Edición especial
p.d: Una edición especial sobre el programa de historias verdaderas enviadas por el público a la actriz Silvia Pinal. Temas de interés general que son censurados por la sociedad.

La doctora Ana María Polo interviene en batallas legales que afectan a los latinos. Como en una corte, las partes presentan testigos y evidencias para que ella emita su decisión. Además, expertos contribuyen con sus conocimientos.
Una condena injusta cambia la vida de Alejandro Gaitán y lo separa de la mujer que ama, Mariana Zambrano. En prisión, se convierte en otra persona y regresa, 17 años más tarde, para vengarse.
Silvia, una tímida enfermera recién graduada, lleva una profunda relación con su madre, Marta. Sin embargo, un diagnóstico cambia la dinámica familiar.
Luis se entera de que su tío regresó después de varios años y cambia su comportamiento repentinamente. Tiempo después la familia descubre cuál es el secreto que hay entre ellos.

Entrevistas a criminales, traficantes, secuestradores y asesinos seriales. Desde los penales de alta seguridad se presentan sus historias y decisiones que llevaron a los protagonistas a cometer crímenes que los marcaron de por vida.

La historia de Yolanda, una hermosa e inteligente reclusa, quien en la cárcel se convierte en la amante de uno de los narcotraficantes más importante del país, Benedictino García, conocido como "El Centauro". Esta relación le da a Yolanda mucho poder, pero también es su pesadilla cuando sale en libertad.
Una condena injusta cambia la vida de Alejandro Gaitán y lo separa de la mujer que ama, Mariana Zambrano. En prisión, se convierte en otra persona y regresa, 17 años más tarde, para vengarse.
Lupe es arrebatada de las manos de sus padres por Tere, quien la obliga a trabajar en las calles. Lupe encuentra en Raúl su salvación, pero la llegada de Anita pone su mundo de cabeza.

Juan Carlos Caballero, un ejecutivo importante de una empresa turística, que solía ser mujeriego, cae en las redes del amor y dos sucesos contrarios lo obligan a huir. Luego, él regresa asumiendo la personalidad de una mujer, Eva, con el fin de conquistar a la mujer que ama, Helena Moreno, una madre soltera, trabajadora y visionaria y de desenmascarar a los culpables causantes de su huida, quienes lo desacreditaron injustamente, al ser acusado de un fraude financiero y de haberle robado el proyecto turístico a Helena. En su nueva personalidad, él está cerca de Helena pero a la vez nunca ha estado tan lejos, las situaciones difíciles que se le presentan al tener que imitar al género opuesto no son tan complicadas como el evitar que sus sentimientos por Helena sean tan evidentes que lo delaten. Una adaptación de la telenovela colombiana "En los Tacones de Eva".

Maite y Diego se conocen en un bar y comienzan una relación, pero él tiene novia y Maite lo descubre. Diego le pide otra oportunidad, pero ella duda si debe aceptar o no.
El profesor Jirafales lleva al Chavo y a sus amigos a ver a un famoso hipnotista francés; el Chavo roba el libro del hipnotista y trata de ayudar a sus vecinos a cambiar su conducta.
Don Ramón trabaja como vendedor de globos y confeti, pero para su mala suerte, sus clientes principales son el Chavo, Quico y Ñoño.
El abuelo de Benito llega al edificio para tomarse la foto familiar. Germán encuentra a un equipo de niños con quien hacer la reta de fútbol.
Morris tiene la tarea de vender unos chocolates de la escuela y a su familia se les ocurre una idea. Lorena manda a arreglar la máquina de escribir de Frankie.
Doña Florinda está sola en casa y, al sintonizar la radio, se entera de que un peligroso loco anda suelto. Asustada, decide llamar al Chapulín Colorado.
El Chapulín Colorado tendrá que luchar contra un robot que no obedece las órdenes de su dueño; al final se llevará una sorpresa.
El señor Barriga no lo soporta más y echa a Don Ramón de la vecindad por falta de pago. En los muebles encuentran dinero y gracias a ello Don Ramón paga sus meses atrasados y se queda en la vecindad.
Don Ramón le enseña al Chavo la técnica del boxeo porque ve en él cualidades pugilísticas. Sin embargo, termina siendo una mala idea.
La madre de Fabiola la ve con Octavio y le prohíbe que lo siga viendo.
Virginia tiene relaciones con Santiago a escondidas. Ella hace un berrinche, por presuntamente haber sido humillada en la ceremonia, y pide irse cuanto antes de la fiesta.

Santos Martínez de la Garza y Treviño es un joven guapo a quien la fortuna le ha sonreído siempre. Nació en Monterrey y desde los cinco años vive en EE. UU. Es dueño de una agencia automotriz, donde conoce a María, con quien tiene un romance.

Severiano del Monte vive con sus cinco hijos adoptivos, pero ante un fallecimiento, la vida de sus hijos cambia el día de la lectura del testamento, con la aparición inesperada de Sara, su hermana, de cuya existencia no sabían.
Una mujer se asusta de un ratón y decide llamar al Chapulín Colorado para que la ayude a cazarlo. Sin embargo, él decide contarle la historia de un famoso ratón, Topo Gigio.
Don Ramón y doña Florinda quieren ir a una fiesta, pero no saben con quién dejar a su bebé, hasta que deciden pedirle ayuda al Chapulín Colorado.

Los casos más controversiales y las disputas de las familias latinas que se resolverán con base a las leyes.
Maite y Diego se conocen en un bar y comienzan una relación, pero él tiene novia y Maite lo descubre. Diego le pide otra oportunidad, pero ella duda si debe aceptar o no.
El profesor Jirafales lleva al Chavo y a sus amigos a ver a un famoso hipnotista francés; el Chavo roba el libro del hipnotista y trata de ayudar a sus vecinos a cambiar su conducta.
Don Ramón trabaja como vendedor de globos y confeti, pero para su mala suerte, sus clientes principales son el Chavo, Quico y Ñoño.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Una reportera de deportes (Lauren Cohan) acusa a un camarógrafo (David Marciano) de violación y acoso; cuando la víctima descubre que está embarazada debido a la violación, la defensa emplea tácticas polémicas esperando ganar el favor del jurado.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Los detectives de la SVU investigan después de que una enfermera escolar advierta múltiples heridas en una joven chica; el detective Amaro trata de crear vínculo con su hijo recientemente descubierto.

La Dra. Choi y April sospechan que la familia de una paciente podría estar abusando de ella. El Dr. Manning y el Dr. Halstead luchan con una familia que tiene un bebé prematuro. La Dra. Rhodes es persuadida de realizar una cirugía arriesgada.

El Dr. Manning lucha con las secuelas de una lesión en la cabeza. El Dr. Manning y el Dr. Halstead tratan con una paciente adolescente y su abrumador marido mayor. El Dr. Rhodes descubre información alarmante sobre la mujer con la que tuvo una cita.
Dawson intenta encontrar el equilibrio con el teniente Casey. Mills se ocupa del futuro sin la escuadra. Severide enfrenta sus demonios. El equipo de Molly se reúne con el inspector de la ciudad.

Casey se ocupa de las consecuencias del divorcio de su hermana. Dawson Mills se asienta en sus nuevas funciones en la estación. Brett no puede decidir lo que quiere para él. El equipo de Molly lucha para conseguir el camión de alimentos.

Casey ayuda a su hermana y se enfrenta a su cuñado corrupto. Brett ayuda a una madre que lo necesita. Mills se entera de la investigación privada sin licencia. Dawson comienza a entrenar con Herrmann.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Rollins investiga un ataque sexual por parte de un hombre enmascarado en una fiesta. Benson descubre a un sospechoso que puede ser valioso como testigo.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Cuando fracasa el caso contra una popular estrella del deporte, Benson indaga en el pasado del sospechoso para descubrir más víctimas. Velasco se decepciona cuando conoce a uno de sus héroes.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: El equipo busca a un sospechoso violento que mató al hijo de un detective. Rollins reflexiona sobre una posible oportunidad.
Atwater se infiltra de incógnito en una organización criminal para arrestar al jefe. Sin embargo, termina viéndose envuelto en una situación que pondrá a prueba a quién es leal.
Upton y Burgess se meten en un serio problema mientras investigan el envío de unas ametralladoras a una exhibición local de armas en Wisconsin.
En el misterioso pueblo de Derry, un payaso llamado Pennywise vuelve 27 años después para atormentar a los ahora adultos miembros del Club de los Perdedores, que se encuentran alejados unos de otros.
Descubra el mundo apasionado y desconocido del rodaje y todos los secretos que no se muestran en la televisión.

Un hombre y su esposa ignoran que a cada uno, como asesino internacional, se le ha asignado matar al otro.
Contratado como guardaespaldas de una niña de nueve años, hija de un rico empresario, un exagente de la CIA se venga de sus captores en México, una ciudad asediada por una ola de secuestros.
Veinticinco años después de la masacre ocurrida en Woodsboro, un nuevo asesino se pone la legendaria máscara para matar adolescentes.

Una monja se suicida en una abadía rumana y el Vaticano envía a un sacerdote y una novicia a investigar lo sucedido. Lo que ambos encuentran allá es un secreto perverso que los enfrentará cara a cara con el mal en su esencia más pura.
Francia, 1956. El asesinato de un sacerdote provoca que un mal demoníaco se extienda sin control. La hermana Irene deberá enfrentarse, de nuevo, a la monja satánica Valak.

Un soldado y una universitaria idealistas se enamoran, pero su amor queda marcado por los múltiples y peligrosos destinos a los que envían a John, el soldado. Durante siete años se comunican habitualmente por carta, pero esto trae consecuencias.
Frank y sus amigos se reúnen en Palm Beach, Sídney, para celebrar el cumpleaños de Frank. Es un fin de semana de paseos en barco, risas y charlas hasta que se va imponiendo la realidad.
En el desierto de México, dos líderes de secta con una pasión por la tortura y el sacrificio humano son revelados cuando eligen a la víctima equivocada.

Justo antes de Año Nuevo, una madre es asesinada en la puerta de su casa; esa misma noche, encuentran siete cadáveres en otra casa; la policía descubre una conexión sorprendente entre los dos crímenes.
Un joven rico no se detiene ante nada para esconder su vida secreta a su familia.
Jennifer Wendorf encuentra a sus padres asesinados y descubre que su hermana desapareció; los investigadores descubren una red complicada que está conectada a un culto de vampiros autoproclamados.
Una mujer recibe un disparo mientras volvía con sus hijos de la cena de Día de Acción de Gracias. La investigación da con un sospechoso insólito, lo que indica que el asesinato no fue azaroso.
Shele Covlin, una banquera millonaria y madre de dos hijos, falleció de forma trágica al resbalar y caerse en la bañera de su casa. Sin embargo, su muerte puede no haber sido un accidente.
Un asesino en serie acecha y ataca a mujeres jóvenes en las afueras de Londres. La exnovia del asesino lo denuncia por maltrato, su testimonio será crucial para hacer justicia.

La misión de rescate de una mujer secuestrada se vuelve macabra cuando son halladas dos mujeres muertas en esa casa. Durante el interrogatorio, el asesino revela la ubicación de más cadáveres. Su media hermana habla sobre una infancia disfuncional.

Un homicidio que involucra a una hija adolescente y su novio que no pueden salir de la mirada del ojo autoritario de una madre; una vez que la policía desentraña las mentiras, descubren la impactante verdad detrás de un plan de asesinato premeditado.

Un maestro de secundaria de California del sur muere repentinamente, por aparentes causas naturales. Pero cuando la policía empieza a investigar a la viuda, descubren su peligroso pasado y su predilección por el veneno.
Cuando una madre es apuñalada hasta la muerte en un horrible ataque, las sospechas recaen sobre sus allegados. Una nota críptica y una violenta racha de crímenes desconciertan a los detectives.
Una vibrante joven madre de tres hijos es asesinada en la seguridad de su propio hogar. Los investigadores se enfocan en una historia de romances problemáticos.
Una aventura de una noche se convierte en un romance del infierno después de que una mujer se entera de los deseos oscuros y mortales de su amante.
Marido y mujer usaban a jóvenes adolescentes como esclavas sexuales para satisfacer sus deseos antes de asesinarlas.
Un vaquero más a gusto con los caballos que la gente desaparece en el desierto después de toparse con un grupo de ganaderos de California que creen que los ha perjudicado.
Edmond le revela a Villefort que Heloise le robó el frasco de veneno, el mismo veneno que se utilizó para asesinar a la marquesa. Villefort se enfrenta a Heloise y la amenaza con delatarla.
Zara es acusada de asesinato al descubrir el alcance del complot de Voltov. Perseguida y sin a quién recurrir, debe huir para evitar una catástrofe.

Un sacerdote es admitido en el hospital tras ver a Jesús sangrando frente a la puerta de su casa. House suma el caso como una distracción para el equipo, mientras se involucra en la relación de Trece y Foreman.

El equipo trata el caso de un niño que no está al tanto de que posee ADN masculino y femenino, y sus padres decidieron su género al momento de nacer. Wilson y Cuddy creen que algo está mal con House cuando empieza a comportarse amablemente.

El equipo atiende a un editor de libros que pierde su inhibición y comienza a decir todo lo que piensa incontrolablemente, hecho que afecta directamente las relaciones más importantes en su vida. House cree que Taub y Wilson le ocultan algo.

La empleada de un asilo enferma tras estar en contacto con un gato que tiene la reputación de visitar a la gente que está a punto de morir. House se dispone a revelar si es un caso verdadero o solo una farsa de la paciente.

Un hombre despierta en un hospital de Nueva York después de un accidente en bicicleta sin poder moverse ni comunicarse. House se encuentra en una cama contigua e insiste en saber cuál es el problema y hace que lo transfieran al Princeton Plainsboro.

Un adolescente se presenta en la sede del FBI con una gran bolsa de fentanilo y solicita la protección del equipo frente a los hombres que dispararon a su padre. Nina le presenta a Scola una propuesta que este duda en aceptar.

El secuestro de una joven regresa al equipo a un caso sin resolver de hace 18 años, lo que empuja a Isobel a reconectarse con su antiguo compañero Jake y a intentar otra vez resolver uno de sus primeros casos en la oficina.
El equipo entra en acción cuando la analista Kelly Moran es tomada como rehén.

Cuando una pareja huye a Albania mientras espera que se dicte sentencia por haber robado millones de los fondos de asistencia para el COVID, el equipo y Jaeger deben lidiar con la amenazadora familia de criminales de la esposa.
El equipo tiene que proteger a una fiscal general estadounidense que se encuentra en Hungría, participando en una reunión de máxima importancia.

Cuando la hermana de Raines desaparece en Kosovo, él hace lo impensable para encontrarla, poniendo su trabajo y su vida en peligro. Kellett y Forrester se enfrentan a una nueva investigación desde dentro de la agencia.
Cassandra se ve envuelta en una situación que pone en peligro su vida, así que Alberg y el Departamento de Policía de Gibson se ponen manos a la obra para encontrar al culpable.
Nathan reconoce un fracaso devastador. Ava se enfrenta a su comprador. Matt adopta un nuevo enfoque.
El hijo de Silvia y Luis no para de llorar y ya no saben qué hacer. Los vecinos les aconsejan cómo cuidar al bebé mientras Germán improvisa un gimnasio en el vestíbulo.

Osiel y Maca son presionados por sus padres, ya que el abuelo los juzga por su apariencia, lo que provoca que Osiel desarrolle una enfermedad que pone en riesgo su vida.

Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

Cher y Dionne son dos de las chicas más populares de una escuela secundaria de Beverly Hills. Su máxima preocupación es llevar la ropa más atractiva y ser tan populares como sea posible. Pero a pesar de su apariencia, Cher tiene un gran corazón.
Raj sale con dos chicas al mismo tiempo y ahora debe lidiar con la culpa. Por otro lado, Penny tiene la oportunidad de actuar en una película. Además, Sheldon debe decidir entre dos sistemas.
Sheldon cree que la teoría de cuerdas es una pérdida de tiempo y sufre una crisis personal. Por otro lado, Howard siente vergüenza en una cita doble.
Sheldon cree que la espontaneidad puede ser una buena idea, pero eso genera problemas para Penny, Bernadette y Amy. Por otro lado, Raj le pide ayuda a Howard para su cita con Emily.
El profesor Protón ayuda a Sheldon a lidiar con la aflicción. Por otro lado, Leonard y Penny compiten. Además, Bernadette y Amy preparan un presente del Día de Star Wars para los muchachos.
Un mal día obliga a Penny a reevaluar sus opciones, Leonard incluido. Por otro lado, Bernadette y Howard deben cuidar a la Sra. Wolowitz. Además, Sheldon aconseja a Raj en temas de relaciones.
Frente a la incertidumbre del futuro, Sheldon considera la posibilidad de hacer un gran cambio. Por otro lado, Emily y Raj deciden dar el siguiente paso.

Raj sale con dos chicas al mismo tiempo y ahora debe lidiar con la culpa. Por otro lado, Penny tiene la oportunidad de actuar en una película. Además, Sheldon debe decidir entre dos sistemas.
Sheldon cree que la teoría de cuerdas es una pérdida de tiempo y sufre una crisis personal. Por otro lado, Howard siente vergüenza en una cita doble.
Sheldon cree que la espontaneidad puede ser una buena idea, pero eso genera problemas para Penny, Bernadette y Amy. Por otro lado, Raj le pide ayuda a Howard para su cita con Emily.
El profesor Protón ayuda a Sheldon a lidiar con la aflicción. Por otro lado, Leonard y Penny compiten. Además, Bernadette y Amy preparan un presente del Día de Star Wars para los muchachos.
Un mal día obliga a Penny a reevaluar sus opciones, Leonard incluido. Por otro lado, Bernadette y Howard deben cuidar a la Sra. Wolowitz. Además, Sheldon aconseja a Raj en temas de relaciones.
Frente a la incertidumbre del futuro, Sheldon considera la posibilidad de hacer un gran cambio. Por otro lado, Emily y Raj deciden dar el siguiente paso.
